label: Tether freezes 12,574 XAUT on Ethereum after Binance hack
note: At Ethereum block 26301003 (2026-10-29 21:11:23 UTC), Tether blacklisted address 0x5227f603C1eE34CE3C06eFe6477003BDfCCB2f8c on the XAUT contract, locking 12,574.05 XAUT (about $50M at late October 2026 gold prices) taken during the October 29 Binance hack.
